title: Daily Devotional #14
paragraphs: Today, as I read Matthew chapter 14, I am struck by the miracle of Jesus feeding the 5000. It's incredible to think about how You can take something as small as five loaves of bread and two fish and multiply it to feed such a large crowd. This is a powerful reminder of Your abundance and provision.

But there's more to this chapter than just the miracle of the loaves and fish. We also see Jesus walking on water, and Peter's attempt to do the same. I am reminded of the importance of faith and trust in You. Peter had faith that he could walk on water, but when he took his eyes off of You and began to focus on the wind and waves, he began to sink. It's a powerful lesson for me to remember to keep my focus on You, even when things around me seem chaotic.

And then there's the story of John the Baptist's death. It's a tragic event, but it's also a reminder of the cost of following You. John was willing to speak the truth and confront those in power, even if it meant his own life. It's a challenge for me to be bold and courageous in my own faith, even if it means facing opposition or persecution.

Overall, Matthew chapter 14 is a powerful reminder of Your provision, the importance of faith and trust, and the cost of following You. Help me to keep my focus on You, to trust in Your abundance, and to be bold and courageous in my faith.
